title: glacier-buffer-replacement-utac — P100: Artificial Glacier Buffer Replacement (AGBR) science
description: Artificial Glacier Buffer Replacement (AGBR) science: proglacial reservoirs and sedimentation limits (Fabbri et al. 2021, Steffen et al. 2022), Managed Aquifer Recharge (Ochoa-Tocachi et al. 2019, Jodar et al. 2022), floating-solar evaporation mitigation (Jin et al. 2023, Ilgen et al. 2024), and the real mass-balance ceiling on full replacement (Farinotti et al. 2016). Includes a clearly-flagged speculative Resilience Replacement Factor / scenario layer. Deliberately has NO UTAC/CREP/AFET bridge. See DISCLAIMER.md. Part of the GenesisAeon ecosystem (P100, companion to glacier-buffer-utac/P99, domain: climate / glacial hydrology / water management).
